about: A week in Seoul (3 - 9 Oct 2026), sanitized and with made-up amounts, in the shapes the app stores. The card's activity export is citibank-activity/ACCT_349_07_10_2026-seoul-sanitized.csv (Citi activity CSV: newest first, the KRW amount printed on the bank line beside the card's SGD, a transfer in, rows before the trip and dollar rows at home). The last two days were not on that export yet: they are Apple Pay purchases the Shortcut saved as foreign currency estimates (the KRW amount kept, the SGD at the day's rate). Standing orders kept running at home. The Seoul trip split group holds two cash expenses in won (no entry) and two paid by card (linked to the card's rows, one booked before the trip).
